evidence_candidates.source_locator: operation technologies, power table, and storage-infrastructure sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: RIKEN gives a design target below 40 MW peak and PUE below 1.1, a 95% water-cooling ratio, and a 2030 release target. It also describes rolling deployment and external-storage links to reduce transition gaps.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: FugakuNEXT has explicit power, cooling, timing, data-link, and continuity design targets.
